previous_statement: Applying lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation with D=D_*, t=t_1, epsilon_R=epsilon, B_R=C^{m+1}, A_R=A, and u_R=u_1 gives an error-improved map v_1:C^{m+1}->A with the same target and amplification form, carrying the inclusion tag and a recorded extended-inclusion defect d_1<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, and satisfying ||v_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon.
new_statement: Applying lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation with D=D_*, t=t_1, epsilon_R=epsilon, B_R=C^{m+1}, A_R=A, and u_R=u_1 gives an error-improved map v_1:C^{m+1}->A and a recorded number d_1<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, with ||v_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, while leaving the source, target corner, and amplification form unchanged. Its registered conclusion does not say that v_1 is an extended d_1-inclusion and does not preserve an inclusion tag; therefore no extended-inclusion conclusion for v_1 follows from this application alone.
